objectives.title: Start a scrap line
objectives.description: Place a Spawner on the bottom row.
objectives.recommendedNextCapability: Add a Seller so raw scrap always has a recovery route.

objectives.title: Create a recovery route
objectives.description: Place a Seller on the top row.
objectives.recommendedNextCapability: Place conveyor belts to connect the Spawner to the Seller.

objectives.title: Connect the line
objectives.description: Place at least 5 conveyor belts to link the Spawner to the Seller.
objectives.recommendedNextCapability: Buy a Can Bale for the Spawner so scrap starts flowing.

objectives.title: Keep the line fed
objectives.description: Buy a Can Bale for the Spawner so scrap starts flowing.
objectives.recommendedNextCapability: Sell a few cans once scrap can reach the Seller.

objectives.title: Prove the raw-selling line
objectives.description: Sell 5 cans. Raw selling remains useful at every stage.
objectives.recommendedNextCapability: Consider licensing a Shredder for higher-value material.

objectives.title: Choose a processing route
objectives.description: Purchase or receive a Shredder license.
objectives.recommendedNextCapability: Place the Shredder when it fits your factory plan.

objectives.title: Add processing
objectives.description: Place one Shredder in the factory grid.
objectives.recommendedNextCapability: Route a can through the Shredder.

objectives.title: Produce processed material
objectives.description: Complete the Shred Can recipe once.
objectives.recommendedNextCapability: Sell the shredded aluminum to realize its increased value.

objectives.title: Realize the processing gain
objectives.recommendedNextCapability: Expand the grid or explore the complementary plastic branch.

objectives.title: Make room for strategy
objectives.description: Purchase any grid expansion when you want more space.
objectives.recommendedNextCapability: Continue with aluminum or branch into plastic processing.
